title: Untitled (Collaboration with Davide DPA)
altText: Stunning 3D geometric graffiti mural by Mr Blob, featuring a surreal snail character with floating eyes and a glowing moon insect against an optical illusion pattern and isometric cubes.
description: Painted in Marconia di Pisticci together with Davide DPA, this wall sets a surreal snail character — wide floating eyes, spiraling amber shells and a patterned butterfly hovering above — against a backdrop of ornamental linework, optical patterns and isometric cubes. The piece thrives on the contrast between the soft, bio-organic character and the sharp geometric abstraction surrounding it.
